lead: Former Kogi governor Ibrahim Idris died in the United Kingdom, and Governor Usman Ododo declared three days of mourning. The government set up a ten-member independent committee on the deaths of 37 mining suspects in Civil Defence custody, and nine people were killed in fresh attacks in Plateau. The APC won the Gombe federal constituency by-election, the Falconets lost 1-0 to Colombia in the U20 World Cup quarter-final, and Victor Osimhen was ruled out of the AFCON qualifiers.

items.h: Former Kogi governor Ibrahim Idris dies in UK
items.s: Alhaji Ibrahim Idris, known as Ibro and a leading PDP figure, died in the United Kingdom. Governor Usman Ododo declared three days of mourning, and Senator Natasha Akpoti-Uduaghan paid tribute.

items.h: Independent committee to probe deaths of 37 mining suspects
items.s: The government set up a ten-member committee and the NSCDC paraded its suspended Niger commandant and arrested more personnel. Former senator Shehu Sani described his own experience of a congested cell as hell on earth.

items.h: Nine killed in fresh Plateau attacks
items.s: At least nine people were killed in Barkin Ladi, Riyom and nearby communities between Saturday night and Sunday morning.

items.h: APC's Kallamu wins Gombe federal by-election
items.s: INEC declared Usman Maijama'a Kallamu winner of the Gombe/Kwami/Funakaye seat with 41,121 votes. INEC chairman Joash Amupitan said Saturday's by-elections in four states were benchmarks for 2027.

items.h: Falconets knocked out by Colombia
items.s: Nigeria lost 1-0 to Colombia in the quarter-finals of the FIFA U20 Women's World Cup after a late goal by Valentina Loboa.

items.h: Osimhen ruled out of AFCON qualifiers
items.s: The Super Eagles said Victor Osimhen will miss the games against Madagascar and Guinea-Bissau with a muscle injury.

items.h: Atiku demands explanation for Tinubu's UNGA absence
items.s: Atiku Abubakar asked President Tinubu to explain why he keeps missing the UN General Assembly.

items.h: APC asks Atiku to spell out how his fuel subsidy would work
items.s: The APC campaign council asked him to state the subsidy rate, spending ceiling, volumes, funding and safeguards against fraud.

items.h: NMDPRA steps up surveillance against petrol price gouging
items.s: The regulator repeated that it cannot fix pump prices but said it will watch for exploitative practices.

items.h: NDC disowns Obi-Kwankwaso Movement's campaign council
items.s: The party distanced itself from the 59-member council, raising the prospect of an internal crisis.

items.h: APC moves to end Wike's feud with its governors
items.s: Party chairman Nentawe Yilwatda returned to Abuja as the APC sought to reconcile the governors and the FCT minister.

items.h: NDLEA officer drowns chasing suspect in Delta
items.s: An officer died after jumping into the River Ethiope at Obiaruku, Ukwuani, in pursuit of fleeing suspects.

items.h: NDLEA seizes N3.4bn of drugs and arrests man posing as police officer
items.s: The agency said the suspect used a forged police ID to pass checkpoints while moving drugs.

items.h: Tinubu praises Kaduna's free CNG bus scheme
items.s: The President urged other governors to copy Governor Uba Sani's free mass transit scheme.

items.h: CPPE warns foreign traders are displacing local retailers
items.s: The think tank said the growing presence of foreign, especially Chinese, traders threatens jobs.

items.h: Edible oil tanker drivers threaten strike from 22 September
items.s: They accused the petroleum tanker drivers' union of interfering in their operations.

items.h: NAHCON denies diverting 5,000 Hajj slots
items.s: The commission called the reports baseless.

items.h: SERAP sues INEC over political donation limits
items.s: The group wants INEC to disclose donation limits and party finances.

items.h: Aiyedatiwa to buy Dangote shares for 500 young entrepreneurs
items.s: The Ondo governor said the purchase will expose youths to investment.

items.h: Woman, 22, arrested over alleged self-kidnap in Anambra
items.s: Police said she collected a N3 million ransom.

items.h: Man found dead hours after leaving home in Jos
items.s: Saleh Gambazi, 34, of Rikkos community left home on Friday evening and was found dead.

items.h: Fire guts Gombe Media Corporation
items.s: Staff and NYSC members lost belongings in the blaze.

items.h: Bauchi Assembly chief whip withdraws from 2027 race
items.s: Musa Wakili Nakwada of Bogoro announced he will not run.

items.h: ADC candidate vows to unseat Ahmad Lawan
items.s: Imamudeen Talba is running for Yobe North.

items.h: Mimiko launches coalition to rally non-APC voters for Tinubu
items.s: Abass Mimiko unveiled the One Love Coalition.

items.h: Ogun PDP deputy candidate rallies Odeda communities
items.s: Yemi Kolapo drew crowds in Obantoko for Ladi Adebutu's campaign.

items.h: Tax Ombud warns against revenue-first reforms
items.s: John Nwabueze said building taxpayer trust matters more than targets, and asked journalists to promote tax literacy.

items.h: NUPRC courts Indonesia ahead of licensing round
items.s: Pertamina signalled interest in the 2026 round.

items.h: S&P rates BOI subsidiary LECON Finance B
items.s: The agency assigned a stable outlook.

items.h: Health groups push sugar-based tax on soft drinks
items.s: Advocates said the excise should depend on sugar content.
